verdict.rationale: Alma presents itself as an immigration law firm for companies, with business-tier custom pricing for programs of 26-250 foreign nationals, a 'business demo', and program-management visibility. It also lists a priced H-1B Change of Employer (transfer) service and an H-1B guide covering the lottery and employer sponsorship. However, none of the evidence documents LCA filing or compliance, employer-side H-1B registration submission, or which employer paperwork the firm handles as a service. Missing for 10: documented LCA/public-access-file compliance service, an explicit H-1B cap registration service for employers, detail on the employer-side paperwork scope, and independent corroboration.
